message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to any incoming data (CSV, JSON, or S3 content) anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected untrusted source handling: S3 downloads use no checksums, signed URLs, or integrity verification; signing is explicitly disabled for public buckets and credentials are empty strings, with no source authentication performed.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline ingests CSV and JSON data and processes it without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to guard against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: No hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are applied when loading any model artifacts or serialized data from S3 or local paths; downloaded content is used directly without integrity validation.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism is present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) or any privacy-preserving training mechanisms are used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are present anywhere in the code; the evaluation only runs Prophet changepoint extraction and moving average impact modeling.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, data signing/hashing, or multiple independent metrics; outputs are simply written to CSV/JSON and uploaded to S3 without any integrity or tamper-detection controls.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, schema, or format validation is performed on any inputs (stock CSV, events CSV, JSON) before they are passed to the model pipeline; errors are caught only at a broad BaseException level with no validation logic.
No detected output bounds checks: The code uploads model outputs directly to S3 without any sanity checks on output values, NaN guards, or probability/threshold bounds verification.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses time-series/stock analysis models (Prophet, moving averages), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
